review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is believed that by some people that advertising can impacts on economic, others say that it has negative social influence; it will make people dissatisfied with who they are have. In my opinion, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Those who advocate emphasize that advertising bring undeniable economic benefits. Since, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. With its engaging content and appealing visual effects, customer demand can be stimulated, meaning that buying power and production can be on the increase. This contributes to more employment opportunities and greater revenues through taxation and this can offer to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam are relied heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Furthermore, jobs can be advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver on economic activity.

However, others believe that advertising has negative social consequences. Since, advertising constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, leading to frustration when they not afford them. It naturally follows that advertising promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I think that both views are valid to some certain extent; advertising may contributed to social dissatisfaction, but its play a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Ảnh đủ hai trang và bài có Introduction, hai Body cùng Conclusion.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn đoạn trên hai trang. Body 1 có được chuỗi demand–production–tax và ví dụ Shopee/Lazada, còn Body 2 đã nối luxury possessions tới dissatisfaction, pressure và frustration. Em cần sửa cấu trúc câu, đặc biệt sau Since và khi dùng advertising làm chủ ngữ, rồi viết Conclusion bằng hai câu ngắn.
review.learningVerdict: Cần hoàn thiện lập luận và độ chính xác.

borrowedVoice.quote: Those who advocate emphasize that advertising bring undeniable economic benefits.
borrowedVoice.comment: Em đã dùng khung mượn lời, nhưng “those who advocate” chưa nói rõ họ ủng hộ điều gì; “advocate” cần một đối tượng hoặc phải đổi thành danh từ chỉ phe. Dùng “On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring.” để gọi đúng supporters of advertising.

borrowedVoice.quote: However, others believe that advertising has negative social consequences.
borrowedVoice.comment: Câu có dấu hiệu gán lời nhưng nhóm người còn chung chung hoặc gọi sai đối tượng, nên chưa tạo được cặp hai phe với Body còn lại. Trong Buổi 27, Body 2 phải gọi rõ những người phản đối hoặc đứng ở phía còn lại; đây là yêu cầu liên kết của khung bài, không phải vì “others/some people” luôn sai ngữ pháp. Dùng “Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences.”.

annotations.title: Khung since

paragraphs: Some people believe that advertising has economic benefits, whereas others think that it creates negative social effects by making people dissatisfied with their lives and possessions. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Engaging content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand, encouraging people to spend more on goods and services. As demand rises, firms can increase production, creating employment opportunities and generating greater state revenue through taxation. This can be clearly seen in e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam, which rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers and expand the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising itself creates direct jobs in marketing, media and design, making the industry an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements constantly display perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions, which may foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. When these items are beyond their budget, this pressure can lead to frustration. In the long run, repeated exposure to such messages may promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture, since people may judge success through what they own.

In conclusion, both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising can contribute to economic growth by stimulating demand, production and employment. At the same time, it can create dissatisfaction and encourage materialistic values among consumers.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
